objective: Compute EV charger reactive-power commands for voltage support after feeder reconfiguration.

objective.en: Use EV inverter reactive capability to raise low feeder voltages toward a target while respecting apparent-power limits.
objective.ru: Использовать реактивную мощность EV-инверторов для повышения низких напряжений фидера к целевому уровню с учётом ограничений полной мощности.

instructions.en: Use v2g_voltage_support_case. For each bus, compute the reactive command needed to reach target_voltage_pu from the linear voltage sensitivity, clipping by the aggregate EV inverter capability at that bus. Report q_dispatch_kvar, corrected_voltage_pu, and total_abs_q_kvar.
instructions.ru: Используйте v2g_voltage_support_case. Для каждой шины вычислите реактивную команду, необходимую для достижения target_voltage_pu по линейной чувствительности напряжения, с ограничением по суммарной capability EV-инверторов на этой шине. Укажите q_dispatch_kvar, corrected_voltage_pu и total_abs_q_kvar.

submission_schema.q_dispatch_kvar: object mapping bus to aggregate reactive command
submission_schema.corrected_voltage_pu: object mapping bus to voltage after support
submission_schema.total_abs_q_kvar: sum of absolute bus reactive commands

hard_constraints: Reactive commands must match target-seeking commands clipped by aggregate EV inverter capability.
Corrected voltages and total absolute reactive effort must match the independent calculation within tolerance.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether submitted EV reactive support satisfies all hard constraints.

source_provenance.title: The Role of Electrical Vehicles for Power Quality and Security during Outages in the Distribution Grid
source_provenance.notes: Grounds EV inverter support for distribution voltage during outages; the task uses compact Volt/VAR capability checks.
